summary: Iteration 33 — Phase-1 real-provider hardening verification (backend only). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_phase1_hardening.py with 18 targeted tests + re-ran the full iter32 regression suite (24 tests). Result: 42/42 PASS. GAP1 verified via a directly-INSERTed pending payment on acme (20000 USD, provider_txn_id=ASYNC_*): POST /providers/mock/webhook with status=succeeded computed fee=610 + net=19390, posted EXACTLY ONE ledger credit==net_minor, and set payment.fee_minor/net_minor accordingly; duplicate webhook returned {already:'succeeded'} and did NOT add a second credit; a synchronous mock payment did NOT get a second credit when a matching success webhook was fired afterward. GAP2 verified: payment_method='card'/flow='direct' persisted + echoed on OUT + reflected in reports/payments.csv (method col) and reconciliation run_detail.method_summary; demo_upi payments persist method='upi'. GAP3 verified: LIVE demo_upi rejected 400 (sandbox-only), LIVE examplepsp with no account rejected 400 ('no live provider account'), LIVE examplepsp with account but no credentials rejected 400 ('no live credentials configured'). GAP4: malformed webhook body -> 400, unknown provider_txn_id -> {unmatched:true}, unknown provider_key -> 404. Unsupported capability (JPY on mock) rejected 400. Tenant isolation (ops-admin cross-tenant) confirmed 403/404. Demo UPI success + failed outcomes still work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: payment_engine.ensure_success_credit correctly reuses fee_engine.compute_fee + ledger_service.post_entry with the _existing_payment_credit==0 idempotency guard, mirroring capture_payment. Verified end-to-end on the ASYNC path (pending → webhook succeeded → 1 credit == net_minor) AND that the sync path is not double-credited. Clean.

config.py provider_inbound_webhook: the {already: prev} short-circuit is reached BEFORE ensure_success_credit runs, which is the correct order — a duplicate success webhook can never trigger a second credit because the payment state is already terminal at that point. Reconfirmed.

GAP3 LIVE credential guard uses `provider.required_credentials()` (list-truthy) + `account.credentials_ref` — the truthy check works for both empty-list plugins (no guard) and populated declarations (guard active). Verified with examplepsp (declares 3 required credential fields) both with and without credentials_ref.

GAP2 payment_method column is now the authoritative source; the metadata_json 'method' fallback in reconciliation._pm_from_payment and reports_export._payment_method is legacy-only. Confirmed reconciliation method_summary reports both 'card' and 'upi' correctly from persisted values (not provider_key guessing).

Nit (report-only, not blocking): _insert_pending_payment in tests had to generate its own UUID because the payments.id column has no server-side default (SQLAlchemy generates it in Python). Not a defect — just something to remember if anyone bypasses the ORM. Adding `DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()` at DB level would harden this belt-and-suspenders.
